async function vaultReadBinary(app, relPath) {
  const a = adapterGet(app);
  if (a && typeof a.readBinary === "function") {
    try { const b = await a.readBinary(relPath); if (b) return b; } catch (e) { /* fallback */ }
  }
  const p = requirePathOrNull();
  const root = app && app.vault && app.vault.adapter && app.vault.adapter.getBasePath ? app.vault.adapter.getBasePath() : null;
  if (p && root) {
    const abs = p.join(root, relPath);
    return fs.readFileSync(abs);
  }
  throw new Error("Lecture binaire impossible: " + relPath);
}

async function vaultWriteBinary(app, relPath, data) {
  const a = adapterGet(app);
  if (a && typeof a.writeBinary === "function") {
    try { await a.writeBinary(relPath, data); return; } catch (e) { /* fallback */ }
  }
  const p = requirePathOrNull();
  const root = app && app.vault && app.vault.adapter && app.vault.adapter.getBasePath ? app.vault.adapter.getBasePath() : null;
  if (p && root) {
    const abs = p.join(root, relPath);
    const dir = p.dirname(abs);
    if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(abs, Buffer.from(data));
    return;
  }
  throw new Error("Écriture binaire impossible: " + relPath);
}

async function vaultMkdir(app, relPath) {
  const a = adapterGet(app);
  if (a && typeof a.mkdir === "function") {
    try { await a.mkdir(relPath); return; } catch (e) { /* fallback */ }
  }
  const p = requirePathOrNull();
  const root = app && app.vault && app.vault.adapter && app.vault.adapter.getBasePath ? app.vault.adapter.getBasePath() : null;
  if (p && root) {
    fs.mkdirSync(p.join(root, relPath), { recursive: true });
  }
}

async function vaultExists(app, relPath) {
  const a = adapterGet(app);
  if (a && typeof a.exists === "function") {
    try { return await a.exists(relPath); } catch (e) { /* fallback */ }
  }
  const p = requirePathOrNull();
  const root = app && app.vault && app.vault.adapter && app.vault.adapter.getBasePath ? app.vault.adapter.getBasePath() : null;
  if (p && root) return fs.existsSync(p.join(root, relPath));
  return false;
}

  return (_nativeModules && _nativeModules.path) ? _nativeModules.path : null;

  // Nom d'entrée pour un média téléchargé depuis internet : downloaded/0.ext
  _downloadTag(idx) {
    return "downloaded/" + idx;
  }

  // Télécharge une image/média/fichier distant si la connexion le permet.
  // Retourne {rel, data} où rel est le chemin d'entrée dans le zip, ou null si
  // le téléchargement échoue (hors-ligne / CORS) — on ne bloque jamais le zip.
  async _downloadRemote(url, baseName) {
    try {
      const resp = await requestUrl({ url, method: "GET", throw: false, responseType: "arraybuffer" });
      const arrBuf = resp && resp.arrayBuffer;
      if (!arrBuf || arrBuf.byteLength === 0) return null;
      const bytes = new Uint8Array(arrBuf);
      // Devine l'extension depuis l'URL (chemin) ou le type MIME retourné
      const pathOnly = url.split(/[?#]/)[0];
      let ext = (pathOnly.match(/\.([a-zA-Z0-9]{1,6})$/i) || [])[1];
      if (!ext) ext = (resp.headers && (resp.headers["content-type"] || resp.headers["Content-Type"] || "").match(/image\/(png|jpeg|jpg|gif|webp|svg)/i) || [])[1] || "bin";
      if (ext === "jpeg") ext = "jpg";
      return { rel: baseName + "." + ext.toLowerCase(), data: bytes };
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn("[mergdown2tex] téléchargement impossible:", url, e);
      return null;
    }
  }

  // Résout un lien (wikilink ou chemin) vers un fichier du vault.
  // 1) via metadataCache.getFirstLinkpathDest (résolution Obsidian native, gère
  //    les basenames, sous-dossiers, espaces...) ;
  // 2) rattrapage : recherche par basename dans app.vault.getFiles() (robuste
  //    même si une image locale avec espaces / sous-dossiers n'est pas résolue).
  _resolveFile(fileRef, sourcePath) {
    try {
      const dest = this.app.metadataCache.getFirstLinkpathDest(fileRef, sourcePath);
      if (dest && dest.path) return dest;
    } catch (e) { /* fallback */ }
    const base = fileRef.replace(/\\/g, "/").split(/[#|]/)[0].trim().replace(/^\/+/, "");
    const baseNoExt = base.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "");
    try {
      const files = this.app.vault.getFiles ? this.app.vault.getFiles() : null;
      if (files && files.length) {
        const lower = (s) => s.toLowerCase();
        // correspondance par chemin relatif complet ou par basename (avec ou sans ext .md)
        const hit = files.find((f) => lower(f.path) === lower(base)
          || lower(f.path) === lower(baseNoExt + ".md")
          || lower(f.name) === lower(base)
          || (lower(f.name).replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "") === lower(baseNoExt) && !lower(base).includes("/")));
        if (hit) return hit;
      }
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    return null;
  }

Il faut contraindre le fallback :

Le fallback matche par **basename SANS ext**. Un wikilink mal résolu (ex: `[[example_writing#...]]` → base `example_writing`) matche `example_writing.md` ET `example_writing.aux` (basename sans ext = `example_writing`). ```
  // Résout un lien (wikilink ou chemin) vers un fichier du vault.
  // 1) via metadataCache.getFirstLinkpathDest (résolution Obsidian native, gère
  //    les basenames, sous-dossiers, espaces...) ;
  // 2) rattrapage : recherche par basename dans app.vault.getFiles() (robuste
  //    même si une image locale avec espaces / sous-dossiers n'est pas résolue).
  _resolveFile(fileRef, sourcePath) {
    try {
      const dest = this.app.metadataCache.getFirstLinkpathDest(fileRef, sourcePath);
      if (dest && dest.path) return dest;
    } catch (e) { /* fallback */ }

    // Nettoyage du nom : retire ancre (…), alias (|), extension déclenchée
    let base = fileRef.replace(/\\/g, "/").split(/[#|]/)[0].trim().replace(/^\/+/, "");
    if (!base) return null;
    const baseNoExt = base.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "");
    const isByPath = base.includes("/");

    // Types de fichiers jamais collectés (artefacts générés / config)
    const GENERATED = /\.(tex|pdf|docx|aux|out|log|fls|toc|toc\.md|bcf|bbl|lof|lot|upa|upb|nav|snm|synctex|vrb|gz|toc\.out)$/i;
    if (GENERATED.test(base)) return null;

    try {
      const files = this.app.vault.getFiles ? this.app.vault.getFiles() : null;
      if (!files || !files.length) return null;
      const L = (s) => s.toLowerCase();

      // Liste des candidats : même chemin relatif exact, ou basename (avec ou
      // sans extension .md pour les notes), hors .obsidian et dossiers _exp.
      const clean = (f) => ({
        f,
        pathL: L(f.path).replace(/^\.obsidian\//i, ""),
        isConfig: /(^|\/)\.obsidian\//.test(f.path) || /_exp\/?/.test(f.path),
        baseL: L(f.name).replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ""),
        pathBaseL: L(f.path).replace(/^\/+/, "").replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ""),
      });
      const list = (files).map(clean).filter((c) => !c.isConfig);

      // 1) préférence chemin relatif complet (avec les deux formes d'extension)
      let match = list.find((c) => c.pathL === L(base)) || list.find((c) => c.pathL === L(baseNoExt + ".md"));
      // 2) wikilink par nom : basename, avec priorité aux .md
      if (!match && !isByPath) {
        const byName = list.filter((c) => c.baseL === L(base) || c.baseL === L(baseNoExt));
        if (byName.length) {
          match = byName.find((c) => c.f.extension === "md")
            || byName.find((c) => c.f.extension === "md")
            || byName[0];
        }
      }
      if (match) return match.f;
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    return null;
  }

**Correctifs :**
1. **Fallback robuste `_resolveFile`** — si `getFirstLinkpathDest` échoue, recherche par basename dans `app.vault.getFiles()` (fonctionne PC + mobile). Avec priorités :
   - `.md` d'abord pour les notes (évite de ramasser `.aux`/`.docx` de même nom)
   - exclusion des **artefacts générés** (`.tex .pdf .docx .aux .out .log .fls .toc .bcf .bbl .lof .lot .upa .upb ...`) → PAS d'artefacts dans le zip
   - exclusion de `.obsidian/` (config) et des dossiers `_exp/`
2. **Images web téléchargées seulement** — ne télécharge `![...](https://...)` QUE si c'est une **image** (préfixe `!`), plus jamais les liens hypertexte ordinaires (`[Google](https://www.google.com)`, `[Vidéo](https://youtube...)`) qui étaient téléchargés à tort.

fn resolve_in_vfs(
    target: &str,
    vault_root: &str,
    md_path: &str,
    vfs: &HashMap<String, String>,
) -> Option<String> {
    let target = target.trim();
    if target.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }

    let p = PathBuf::from(target);
    let basename = p.file_name().and_then(|s| s.to_str()).unwrap_or(target);
    let basename_no_md = basename.trim_end_matches(".md");

    // Obsidian resolves `![[Name]]` / `[[Name]]` by note name across the vault,
    // so first try flat vfs keys (basename / basename without .md / raw target).
    for key in [target, basename, basename_no_md] {
        let k = key.replace('\\', "/");
        if let Some(content) = vfs.get(&k) {
            return Some(content.clone());
        }
        if let Some(content) = vfs.get(k.trim_end_matches(".md")) {
            return Some(content.clone());
        }
    }

    let candidates = if p.is_absolute() {
        vec![p.to_string_lossy().to_string()]
    } else {
        let mut c = Vec::new();
        // relative to md_path parent
        if let Some(parent) = PathBuf::from(md_path).parent() {
            c.push(parent.join(target).to_string_lossy().to_string());
            c.push(parent.join(basename).to_string_lossy().to_string());
            c.push(
                parent
                    .join(basename)
                    .with_extension("md")
                    .to_string_lossy()
                    .to_string(),
            );
        }
        // relative to vault_root
        c.push(
            PathBuf::from(vault_root)
                .join(target)
                .to_string_lossy()
                .to_string(),
        );
        c.push(
            PathBuf::from(vault_root)
                .join(basename)
                .to_string_lossy()
                .to_string(),
        );
        c.push(
            PathBuf::from(vault_root)
                .join(basename)
                .with_extension("md")
                .to_string_lossy()
                .to_string(),
        );
        c
    };

    for candidate in &candidates {
        let normalized = candidate.replace('\\', "/");
        if let Some(content) = vfs.get(&normalized) {
            return Some(content.clone());
        }
        // Also try without the md extension if the target didn't have one
        if !target.ends_with(".md") && normalized.ends_with(".md") {
            let without_md = normalized.trim_end_matches(".md");
            if let Some(content) = vfs.get(without_md) {
                return Some(content.clone());
            }
        }
    }
    None
}

lazy_static! {
    // Obsidian property blocks: a line of `%%` ... `%%` (YAML encoded as comment)
    static ref FM_BLOCK_RE: Regex =
        Regex::new(r"(?m)^\s*%%[^\n]*%%\s*$").unwrap();
    // Metadata lines `key:: value` (caption, widths, package, size_in_latex, ...)
    static ref META_LINE_RE: Regex =
        Regex::new(r"(?m)^[^:\n]+::\s*[^\n]*\s*$").unwrap();
    // Header/marker lines inside block notes: `# %%expr%%`, `# %%table%%`, `%% fig %%`, `%% table %%`
    static ref BLOCK_HEADER_RE: Regex =
        Regex::new(r"(?m)^\s*#{1,6}\s*%%[a-zA-Z ]*%%\s*$").unwrap();
    static ref BLOCK_MARKER_RE: Regex =
        Regex::new(r"(?m)^\s*%%[a-zA-Z ]*%%\s*$").unwrap();
    // Dataview inline expression used for table captions
    static ref DV_CAPTION_RE: Regex =
        Regex::new(r"(?m)^\s*`=this\.caption`\s*$").unwrap();
    // Final cleanup: collapse leftover blank lines
    static ref BLANK_RUN_RE: Regex = Regex::new(r"\n{3,}").unwrap();
}

/// Strip Obsidian property blocks, metadata lines and the template header/marker
/// lines (e.g. `# %%expr%%`, `%% fig %%`, `` `=this.caption` ``) from a note's
/// content so that when it is inlined its body appears clean, without leaking
/// `\section{...}` / stray text into the converted LaTeX.

  /**
   * Préparation du contenu pour l'aplatissement dans le WASM (Rust) :
   * - résout uniquement les images `![[img.png]]` -> `![alt](relpath)` (le WASM ne gère pas les images)
   * - garde les embeds natifs `![[note]]` dans `processed` : c'est le WASM (expand_embeds_recursive)
   *   qui les inline, nettoie le contenu et injecte les marqueurs `^id` + refs `[[#^id|..]]`
   * - construit le vfs (contenu brut des notes de bloc, images résolues) keyé par chemin absolu
   *   ET par basename (sans .md) pour que le WASM résolve `![[Nom]]` par nom.
   */
  async processEmbedsWithMarkers(content, sourceFile, vaultRoot, parentDir, depth = 0) {
    if (depth > 10) return { processed: content, vfs: {} };
    const vfs = {};
    let processed = content;

    const imgPattern = /!\[\[([^\]|#]+\.(?:png|jpg|jpeg|gif|svg|webp))(?:\|[^\]]*)?\]\]/gi;
    const resolveImages = (text) => text.replace(imgPattern, (full, fileRef) => {
      let resolved = this.app.metadataCache.getFirstLinkpathDest(fileRef, sourceFile.path);
      if (!resolved) return full;
      const absPath = path.join(vaultRoot, resolved.path);
      const relPath = path.relative(parentDir, absPath);
      return `![${resolved.basename}](${relPath})`;
    });

    processed = resolveImages(processed);

    // Embeds natifs .md : on lit le contenu brut de chaque note et on le met dans le vfs
    const mdPattern = /!\[\[([^\]|#]+)(?:#([^\]|]+))?(?:\|([^\]\n]+))?\]\]/g;
    const matches = [];
    let m;
    while ((m = mdPattern.exec(processed)) !== null) {
      const ext = path.extname(m[1]).slice(1).toLowerCase();
      if (!ext || ext === 'md') matches.push({ fileRef: m[1] });
    }

    for (const { fileRef } of matches) {
      const resolved = this.app.metadataCache.getFirstLinkpathDest(fileRef, sourceFile.path);
      if (!resolved || resolved.extension !== 'md') continue;
      const absPath = path.join(vaultRoot, resolved.path).replace(/\\/g, "/");
      if (!vfs[absPath]) {
        const rawContent = await this.app.vault.read(resolved);
        // On résout les images de la note, on garde `![[autre_note]]` natif pour le WASM
        const noteContent = resolveImages(rawContent);
        const { vfs: childVfs } = await this.processEmbedsWithMarkers(
          noteContent, resolved, vaultRoot, parentDir, depth + 1,
        );
        Object.assign(vfs, childVfs);
        vfs[absPath] = noteContent;
        // Clé par basename (sans .md) : le WASM résout `![[Nom]]` / `[[Nom]]` par nom
        if (!vfs[resolved.basename]) vfs[resolved.basename] = noteContent;
      }
    }

    return { processed, vfs };
  }

  // blocs mermaid bruts) qui concourent au fichier actif, dans l'ordre logique
  // de leurs dossiers du vault. N'inclut AUCUN artefact généré (.tex/.pdf/.docx).
  // Fonctionne sur PC et Android via getFirstLinkpathDest + app.vault.adapter.

## Réponse à ta question architecturale

**Pourquoi il y a une partie JS pour le zip si le WASM .rs résout déjà les embeds ?**

Le **WASM Rust** (`expand_embeds_recursive` + `resolve_in_vfs`) résout les embeds `.md` et les inline en **TEXTE** — c'est fait pour la CONVERSION (produire du Markdown/LaTeX). Il travaille sur un **vfs de contenus texte** (HashMap chemin→contenu). Il ne peut **pas** :
- lire les **fichiers binaires** (PNG/PDF/MP3) du vault — le WASM n'a pas accès au système de fichiers d'Obsidian ;
- écrire un **fichier .zip** (nécessite des octets binaires + CRC32 + structure zip) ;
- télécharger des images internet (`requestUrl` est une API Obsidian côté JS).

Donc, pour un **.zip de ressources binaires**, une couche JS est **obligatoire**. Ce n'est pas une duplication inutile : c'est que le WASM est conçu pour le texte, pas pour emballer des fichiers dans une archive.

**Cependant, tu as raison sur un point** : la **résolution des liens** (basename → fichier) existe déjà de façon éprouvée dans le WASM (`resolve_in_vfs`) et côté JS (`processEmbedsWithMarkers`/`getFirstLinkpathDest`). Mon `_resolveFile` la réutilise (getFirstLinkpathDest d'abord, puis basename via getFiles en secours — le même principe que `resolve_in_vfs` Rust qui essaie basename à travers le vault). Donc je ne réinvente pas la règle de résolution, je l'applique pour retrouver les **chemins de fichiers** à lire en binaire.

  async zipRelatedResources() {
    const activeFile = this.app.workspace.getActiveFile();
    if (!activeFile || activeFile.extension !== "md") {
      new Notice("Sélectionnez un fichier Markdown.");
      return;
    }
    new Notice("Collecte des ressources liées...");
    try {
      const seen = new Set();
      const files = await this.collectRelatedResources(activeFile, 0, seen);

      // Nom du zip : <nom_fichier>_exp.zip, dans le même dossier que le fichier
      const parentRel = (activeFile.parent && activeFile.parent.path
        ? activeFile.parent.path.replace(/^\/+/, "")
        : "");
      const zipName = activeFile.basename + "_exp.zip";
      const zipRel = (parentRel ? parentRel + "/" : "") + zipName;

      const entries = [];
      for (const [name, data] of files) entries.push({ name, data });

      const zipBytes = buildZip(entries);

      await vaultMkdir(this.app, parentRel || "/");
      await vaultWriteBinary(this.app, zipRel, zipBytes);
      try { this.app.workspace.trigger("layout-change"); } catch (e) {}
      new Notice(`✅ ZIP créé : ${zipName} (${entries.length} fichiers, ${(zipBytes.length / 1024).toFixed(0)} Ko)`);
      console.log("[mergdown2tex] zip written:", zipRel, zipBytes.length, "entries:", entries.length);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("[mergdown2tex] zip error:", e);
      new Notice("❌ Erreur ZIP: " + e.message, 6000);
    }
  }

    if (!activeFile || activeFile.extension !== "md") return files;

    const log = (msg) => { if (diag) diag.push(msg); };;

    const store = (relPath, data) => {
      const key = relPath.replace(/^\/+/, "").replace(/\\/g, "/");
      if (key && !files.has(key)) files.set(key, data);
    };

    const addByDest = async (fileRef, sourcePath) => {
      let dest = null;
      try { dest = this._resolveFile(fileRef, sourcePath); } catch (e) {}
      if (!dest || !dest.path) {
        log(`[LINK] "${fileRef}" (depuis ${sourcePath}) -> NON RÉSOLU (getFirstLinkpathDest + getFiles)`);
        return;
      }
      const rel = dest.path.replace(/^\/+/, "").replace(/\\/g, "/");
      if (files.has(rel) || seen.has(rel)) {
        log(`[LINK] "${fileRef}" -> déjà inclus (${rel})`);
        return;
      }
      seen.add(rel);
      // Lecture binaire (images) ou texte (notes)
      const isMd = dest.extension === "md";
      let data;
      try {
        if (isMd) {
          data = new TextEncoder().encode(await this.app.vault.read(dest));
          store(rel, data);
          log(`[EMBED] "${fileRef}" -> ${rel} (${data.length} o) — récursion…`);
          // Récursion sur les embeds de cette note
          const sub = await this.collectRelatedResources(dest, depth + 1, seen, diag);
          for (const [k, v] of sub) if (!files.has(k)) files.set(k, v);
        } else {
          data = await vaultReadBinary(this.app, rel);
          if (data && data.length > 0) {
            store(rel, data);
            log(`[FICHIER] "${fileRef}" -> ${rel} (${data.length} o)`);
          } else {
            log(`[FICHIER] "${fileRef}" -> ${rel} : lecture vide`);
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {
        log(`[FICHIER] "${fileRef}" -> ${rel} : ERREUR LECTURE: ${(e && e.message) || e}`);

  _downloadTag(idx) {

  // Résout un lien (wikilink ou chemin) vers un fichier du vault.
  // 1) via metadataCache.getFirstLinkpathDest (résolution Obsidian native, gère
  //    les basenames, sous-dossiers, espaces...) ;
  // 2) rattrapage : recherche par basename dans app.vault.getFiles() (robuste
  //    même si une image locale avec espaces / sous-dossiers n'est pas résolue).
  _resolveFile(fileRef, sourcePath) {
    try {
      const dest = this.app.metadataCache.getFirstLinkpathDest(fileRef, sourcePath);
      if (dest && dest.path) return dest;
    } catch (e) { /* fallback */ }

    // Nettoyage du nom : retire ancre (…), alias (|), extension déclenchée
    let base = fileRef.replace(/\\/g, "/").split(/[#|]/)[0].trim().replace(/^\/+/, "");
    if (!base) return null;
    const baseNoExt = base.replace(/\.[^.]+$/, "");
    const isByPath = base.includes("/");

    // Types de fichiers jamais collectés (artefacts générés / config)
    const GENERATED = /\.(tex|pdf|docx|aux|out|log|fls|toc|toc\.md|bcf|bbl|lof|lot|upa|upb|nav|snm|synctex|vrb|gz|toc\.out)$/i;
    if (GENERATED.test(base)) return null;

    try {
      const files = this.app.vault.getFiles ? this.app.vault.getFiles() : null;
      if (!files || !files.length) return null;
      const L = (s) => s.toLowerCase();

      // Liste des candidats : même chemin relatif exact, ou basename (avec ou
      // sans extension .md pour les notes), hors .obsidian et dossiers _exp.
      const clean = (f) => ({
        f,
        pathL: L(f.path).replace(/^\.obsidian\//i, ""),
        isConfig: /(^|\/)\.obsidian\//.test(f.path) || /_exp\/?/.test(f.path),
        baseL: L(f.name).replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ""),
        pathBaseL: L(f.path).replace(/^\/+/, "").replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ""),
      });
      const list = (files).map(clean).filter((c) => !c.isConfig);

      // 1) préférence chemin relatif complet (avec les deux formes d'extension)
      let match = list.find((c) => c.pathL === L(base)) || list.find((c) => c.pathL === L(baseNoExt + ".md"));
      // 2) wikilink par nom : basename, avec priorité aux .md
      if (!match && !isByPath) {
        const byName = list.filter((c) => c.baseL === L(base) || c.baseL === L(baseNoExt));
        if (byName.length) {
          match = byName.find((c) => c.f.extension === "md") || byName[0];
        }
      }
      if (match) return match.f;
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    return null;

    if (/(^|\/)\.obsidian\//.test(s)) return true;
    if (/_exp\/?/.test(s)) return true;
    if (/\.(tex|pdf|docx|aux|out|log|fls|toc|bcf|bbl|lof|lot|upa|upb|nav|snm|synctex|vrb|gz|fls\.vrb|toc\.out)$/i.test(s)) return true;

    if (this._isGeneratedOrConfigPath(base)) return null;

    try {
      const files = this.app.vault.getFiles ? this.app.vault.getFiles() : null;
      if (!files || !files.length) return null;
      const L = (s) => s.toLowerCase();

      // Liste des candidats : même chemin relatif exact, ou basename (avec ou
      // sans extension .md pour les notes), hors .obsidian, dossiers _exp et
      // fichiers générés.
      const clean = (f) => ({
        f,
        pathL: L(f.path).replace(/^\.obsidian\//i, ""),
        isConfig: this._isGeneratedOrConfigPath(f.path),
        baseL: L(f.name).replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ""),
        pathBaseL: L(f.path).replace(/^\/+/, "").replace(/\.[^.]+$/, ""),
      });
      const list = (files).map(clean).filter((c) => !c.isConfig);

      // 1) préférence chemin relatif complet (avec les deux formes d'extension)
      let match = list.find((c) => c.pathL === L(base)) || list.find((c) => c.pathL === L(baseNoExt + ".md"));
      // 2) wikilink par nom : basename, avec priorité aux .md
      if (!match && !isByPath) {
        const byName = list.filter((c) => c.baseL === L(base) || c.baseL === L(baseNoExt));
        if (byName.length) {
          match = byName.find((c) => c.f.extension === "md") || byName[0];
        }
      }
      if (match) return match.f;
    } catch (e) { /* ignore */ }
    return null;
```

async function vaultReadBinary(app, relPath) {
  const a = adapterGet(app);
  if (a && typeof a.readBinary === "function") {
    try { const b = await a.readBinary(relPath); if (b) return b; } catch (e) { /* fallback */ }
  }

  const root = app && app.vault && app.vault.adapter && app.vault.adapter.getBasePath ? app.vault.adapter.getBasePath() : null;
  if (p && root) {
    const abs = p.join(root, relPath);
    return fs.readFileSync(abs);
  }
  throw new Error("Lecture binaire impossible: " + relPath);
}

Donc `data.length` serait `undefined`, et `data && data.length > 0` → `undefined > 0` = false → "lecture vide" !

C'est un bug classique. `adapter.readBinary` retourne un `ArrayBuffer` (ou le résultat n'est pas un objet avec `length`). Il faut convertir en `Uint8Array`/`Buffer`.

async function vaultReadBinary(app, relPath) {
  const asBytes = (x) => {
    if (!x) return null;
    if (x instanceof Uint8Array) return x;
    if (typeof ArrayBuffer !== "undefined" && x instanceof ArrayBuffer) return new Uint8Array(x);
    if (typeof x.buffer === "object" && x.buffer instanceof ArrayBuffer) return new Uint8Array(x.buffer, x.byteOffset || 0, x.byteLength || x.length);
    if (typeof Buffer !== "undefined" && Buffer.isBuffer(x)) return new Uint8Array(x.buffer, x.byteOffset, x.byteLength);
    if (x.length || x.byteLength) return new Uint8Array(x.buffer || x);
    return null;
  };
  const a = adapterGet(app);
  if (a && typeof a.readBinary === "function") {
    try { return asBytes(await a.readBinary(relPath)); } catch (e) { /* fallback */ }
  }
  const p = requirePathOrNull();
  const root = app && app.vault && app.vault.adapter && app.vault.adapter.getBasePath ? app.vault.adapter.getBasePath() : null;
  if (p && root) {
    const abs = p.join(root, relPath);
    return asBytes(fs.readFileSync(abs));
  }
  throw new Error("Lecture binaire impossible: " + relPath);
}

async function vaultWriteBinary(app, relPath, data) {
  const bytes = (data instanceof Uint8Array) ? data : new Uint8Array(data);
  const a = adapterGet(app);
  if (a && typeof a.writeBinary === "function") {
    try { await a.writeBinary(relPath, bytes); return; } catch (e) { /* fallback */ }
  }
  const p = requirePathOrNull();
  const root = app && app.vault && app.vault.adapter && app.vault.adapter.getBasePath ? app.vault.adapter.getBasePath() : null;
  if (p && root) {
    const abs = p.join(root, relPath);
    const dir = p.dirname(abs);
    if (!fs.existsSync(dir)) fs.mkdirSync(dir, { recursive: true });
    fs.writeFileSync(abs, Buffer.from(bytes));
    return;
  }
  throw new Error("Écriture binaire impossible: " + relPath);
}

## 🎯 Cause racine trouvée (grâce au diagnostic)

Le diagnostic du VRAI Obsidian montrait :
```
[FICHIER] "Pasted image 20240609012140.png" -> Writing/figure blocks/Pasted image 20240609012140.png : lecture vide
```

**La résolution fonctionnait parfaitement** (le bon chemin était trouvé) — mais la **lecture binaire échouait**. Le bug était dans `vaultReadBinary` : sur desktop, `app.vault.adapter.readBinary()` retourne un **`ArrayBuffer`** (qui n'a pas `.length`, mais `.byteLength`). Mon test `data && data.length > 0` échouait donc silencieusement → les images étaient résolues mais **jamais stockées dans le zip**.

## ✅ Fix
`vaultReadBinary` convertit désormais tout retour (ArrayBuffer, Uint8Array, Buffer, ..) en un vrai `Uint8Array` fiable via un helper `asBytes()`. Vérifié : fichier de 419 688 o lu correctement, `data.length > 0` vrai.

## 📄 Où est le diagnostic
Le fichier `Writing/full_manual_repport_diag.txt` est **dans le zip** `full_manual_repport_exp.zip` (il faut dézipper pour le voir). Le zip de 15:08 l'affichait déjà.

  async zipRelatedResources() {
    const activeFile = this.app.workspace.getActiveFile();
    if (!activeFile || activeFile.extension !== "md") {
      new Notice("Sélectionnez un fichier Markdown.");
      return;
    }
    new Notice("Collecte des ressources liées...");
    try {
      const seen = new Set();
      const diag = [];
      diag.push("=== DIAGNOSTIC ZIP des ressources liées ===");
      diag.push("Fichier actif : " + activeFile.path);
      const files = await this.collectRelatedResources(activeFile, 0, seen, diag);

      // Inventaire des images/médias/binaires présents dans le vault (pour
      // comprendre ce qui est trouvable vs manquant)
      try {
        const vaultFiles = this.app.vault.getFiles ? this.app.vault.getFiles() : [];
        const binaires = vaultFiles.filter((f) => {
          if (/(^|\/)\.obsidian\//.test(f.path) || /_exp\/?/.test(f.path)) return false;
          const e = f.extension.toLowerCase();
          return ["png","jpg","jpeg","gif","webp","svg","pdf","mp3","mp4","wav","ogg","mov","avi","mkv","mpg","mpeg","flac","aac","m4a"].includes(e);
        }).sort((a, b) => a.path.localeCompare(b.path));
        diag.push("");
        diag.push("=== Binaires (images/audio/video/pdf) du vault, hors .obsidian : " + binaires.length + " ===");
        if (binaires.length <= 200) {
          for (const f of binaires) diag.push("  " + f.path);
        } else {
          const byExt = {};
          for (const f of binaires) { const e = (f.extension || "?").toLowerCase(); byExt[e] = (byExt[e] || 0) + 1; }
          diag.push("  (trop nombreux, voici le récapitulatif par type : " + JSON.stringify(byExt) + ")");
          diag.push("  Les 50 premiers :");
          for (const f of binaires.slice(0, 50)) diag.push("   - " + f.path);
        }
      } catch (e) {
        diag.push("(getFiles indisponible : " + ((e && e.message) || e) + ")");
      }

      diag.push("");
      diag.push("=== Résolution des liens ===");
      // les logs de collecte ont déjà été poussés dans `diag`

      // Nom du zip : <nom_fichier>_exp.zip, dans le même dossier que le fichier
      const parentRel = (activeFile.parent && activeFile.parent.path
        ? activeFile.parent.path.replace(/^\/+/, "")
        : "");
      const zipName = activeFile.basename + "_exp.zip";
      const zipRel = (parentRel ? parentRel + "/" : "") + zipName;

      const entries = [];
      for (const [name, data] of files) entries.push({ name, data });
      // Fichier de diagnostic inclus dans le zip
      const diagName = (parentRel ? parentRel + "/" : "") + activeFile.basename + "_diag.txt";
      entries.push({ name: diagName, data: new TextEncoder().encode(diag.join("\n") + "\n") });

      const zipBytes = buildZip(entries);

      await vaultMkdir(this.app, parentRel || "/");
      await vaultWriteBinary(this.app, zipRel, zipBytes);
      try { this.app.workspace.trigger("layout-change"); } catch (e) {}
      new Notice(`✅ ZIP créé : ${zipName} (${entries.length} fichiers, ${(zipBytes.length / 1024).toFixed(0)} Ko) + diagnostic`);
      console.log("[mergdown2tex] zip written:", zipRel, zipBytes.length, "entries:", entries.length);
      console.log(diag.join("\n"));
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("[mergdown2tex] zip error:", e);
      new Notice("❌ Erreur ZIP: " + e.message, 6000);
    }
  }

  async loadSettings() {
    this.settings = Object.assign({}, DEFAULT_SETTINGS, await this.loadData());
  }

  async saveSettings() {
    await this.saveData(this.settings);
  }

  /**

   * Obsidian ne peut pas ouvrir les .tex, donc on part toujours du .md.

  async texToMarkdown() {
    if (typeof Platform !== "undefined" && !Platform.isDesktop) {
      return this.texToMarkdownMobile();
    }
    if (!this.vlatex) {
      new Notice("vLaTeX WASM non initialisé.");
      return;
    }
    const fp = await this.getFilePaths();
    if (!fp) return;
    const { parentDir, fileStem } = fp;

    const texPath = path.join(parentDir, fileStem + ".tex");
    if (!fs.existsSync(texPath)) {
      new Notice(`❌ Fichier LaTeX introuvable : ${fileStem}.tex\nConvertissez d'abord en LaTeX.`);
      return;
    }

    try {
      new Notice("Conversion LaTeX vers Markdown en cours...");
      const texContent = fs.readFileSync(texPath, "utf-8");
      const markdown = this.vlatex.latex_to_markdown(texContent);
      const mdOutPath = path.join(parentDir, fileStem + "_conv.md");
      fs.writeFileSync(mdOutPath, markdown, "utf-8");
      console.log("[mergdown2tex] .md written to", mdOutPath, markdown.length, "bytes");
      new Notice(`✅ Markdown généré: ${fileStem}_conv.md (${markdown.length} octets)`);
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("[mergdown2tex] tex->md error:", err);
      new Notice("❌ Erreur: " + err.message);
    }
  }

  async compilePdfMobile() {
    if (!this.vlatex) { new Notice("vLaTeX WASM non initialisé."); return; }
    const activeFile = this.app.workspace.getActiveFile();
    if (!activeFile || activeFile.extension !== "md") { new Notice("Sélectionnez un fichier Markdown."); return; }
    new Notice("Compilation PDF (Pandoc WASM + Typst)...");
    try {
      const { parentDir, fileStem, fullTex, content } = await this.convertToLatexMobile(activeFile);

      const texRel = (parentDir ? parentDir + "/" : "") + fileStem + ".tex";
      try { await vaultMkdir(this.app, (parentDir || "/")); } catch (e) {}
      await vaultWriteText(this.app, texRel, fullTex);
      new Notice("Fichier .tex écrit. Initialisation de Typst...");

      const wasmEngine = await this.getPandocWasmEngine();
      const typCompiler = await this.getTypstCompiler();
      const wasmFS = new WasmFileSystem(this.app.vault, "");
      const numberSectionsFlag = this.settings.enableDocxNumbering ? " --number-sections" : "";
      const inputRel = ("/" + texRel).replace(/\\/g, "/");
      const outRel = "/" + (parentDir ? parentDir + "/" : "") + fileStem + ".pdf";
      const outputRel = outRel.replace(/\\/g, "/");
      // -t typst convertit directement markdown->typst (évite le /tmp/media du chemin pdf)
      const wasmCmd = `pandoc "${inputRel}" -t typst -o "${outputRel}"${numberSectionsFlag}`;

      let resources = [];
      const imgRe = /\\includegraphics(?:\[[^}]*\])?\{([^}]+)\}/g;
      let imgMatch;
      while ((imgMatch = imgRe.exec(fullTex)) !== null) {
        const imgRel = imgMatch[1].replace(/^\.\//, "");
        let full = (parentDir ? parentDir + "/" : "") + imgRel;
        if (await vaultExists(this.app, full)) resources.push("/" + full);
      }

      console.log("[mergdown2tex][mobile] running Pandoc WASM (typst):", wasmCmd);
      const result = await runPandocWasm(wasmEngine, wasmFS, {
        command: wasmCmd,
        vaultDir: "",
        resources,
        embeds: [],
        typst: typCompiler,
      });
      if (result.stderr) console.log("[mergdown2tex][mobile] pandoc stderr:", result.stderr);

      const pdfRel = (parentDir ? parentDir + "/" : "") + fileStem + ".pdf";
      const pdfBytes = await this.app.vault.adapter.readBinary(pdfRel);
      if (pdfBytes && pdfBytes.length > 4 && pdfBytes[0] === 0x25 && pdfBytes[1] === 0x50) {
        new Notice("✅ PDF compilé sur mobile !");
      } else {
        new Notice("⚠️ PDF généré mais non-lisible : " + (result.stderr || "diagnostic Typst"), 8000);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("[mergdown2tex][mobile] PDF error:", e);
      new Notice("❌ Erreur PDF mobile: " + e.message);
    }
  }

  async convertToLatexMobile(activeFile, vaultRoot, mdPath) {
    // Pipeline LaTeX simplifié pour mobile : utilise UNIQUEMENT le WASM embarqué
    // et app.vault.adapter (aucun fs/podman/mermaid).
    // NB: sur Android, activeFile.parent.path peut commencer par "/" ; on normalise
    // pour éviter des chemins "///Dossier avec espace/..." qui cassent les args pandoc.
    const parentDir = (activeFile.parent ? activeFile.parent.path : "").replace(/^\/+/, "");
    const fileStem = activeFile.basename;
    const content = await this.app.vault.read(activeFile);
    let processed = this.processDataviewInline(content, activeFile);
    const vfs = {};
    const vfsJson = JSON.stringify(vfs);
    const expanded = this.vlatex.expand_wikilinks_with_vfs(processed, vaultRoot || "", mdPath || activeFile.path, vfsJson);
    const body = this.vlatex.markdown_to_latex_with_vfs(expanded, "default", vfsJson);
    const fullTex = this.assembleFullDocument(content, body, true, vaultRoot || "", parentDir || "");
    return { parentDir, fileStem, fullTex: fullTex.tex, content };
  }

    new Notice("Compilation DOCX (Pandoc WASM)...");
    try {
      const { parentDir, fileStem, fullTex, content } = await this.convertToLatexMobile(activeFile);

      const relParentDir = parentDir || "";
      const docxTexRel = (relParentDir ? relParentDir + "/" : "") + fileStem + "_docx.tex";

  async compilePdfMobile() {
    if (!this.vlatex) { new Notice("vLaTeX WASM non initialisé."); return; }
    const activeFile = this.app.workspace.getActiveFile();
    if (!activeFile || activeFile.extension !== "md") { new Notice("Sélectionnez un fichier Markdown."); return; }
    new Notice("Compilation PDF (Pandoc WASM + Typst)...");
    try {
      const { parentDir, fileStem, fullTex, content } = await this.convertToLatexMobile(activeFile);

      const texRel = (parentDir ? parentDir + "/" : "") + fileStem + ".tex";
      try { await vaultMkdir(this.app, (parentDir || "/")); } catch (e) {}
      await vaultWriteText(this.app, texRel, fullTex);
      new Notice("Fichier .tex écrit. Initialisation de Typst...");

      const wasmEngine = await this.getPandocWasmEngine();
      const typCompiler = await this.getTypstCompiler();
      const wasmFS = new WasmFileSystem(this.app.vault, "");
      const numberSectionsFlag = this.settings.enableDocxNumbering ? " --number-sections" : "";
      const inputRel = ("/" + texRel).replace(/\\/g, "/");
      const outRel = "/" + (parentDir ? parentDir + "/" : "") + fileStem + ".pdf";
      const outputRel = outRel.replace(/\\/g, "/");
      // -t typst convertit directement markdown->typst (évite le /tmp/media du chemin pdf)
      const wasmCmd = `pandoc "${inputRel}" -t typst -o "${outputRel}"${numberSectionsFlag}`;

      let resources = [];
      const imgRe = /\\includegraphics(?:\[[^}]*\])?\{([^}]+)\}/g;
      let imgMatch;
      while ((imgMatch = imgRe.exec(fullTex)) !== null) {
        const imgRel = imgMatch[1].replace(/^\.\//, "");
        let full = (parentDir ? parentDir + "/" : "") + imgRel;
        if (await vaultExists(this.app, full)) resources.push("/" + full);
      }

      console.log("[mergdown2tex][mobile] running Pandoc WASM (typst):", wasmCmd);
      const result = await runPandocWasm(wasmEngine, wasmFS, {
        command: wasmCmd,
        vaultDir: "",
        resources,
        embeds: [],
        typst: typCompiler,
      });
      if (result.stderr) console.log("[mergdown2tex][mobile] pandoc stderr:", result.stderr);

      const pdfRel = (parentDir ? parentDir + "/" : "") + fileStem + ".pdf";
      const pdfBytes = await this.app.vault.adapter.readBinary(pdfRel);
      if (pdfBytes && pdfBytes.length > 4 && pdfBytes[0] === 0x25 && pdfBytes[1] === 0x50) {
        new Notice("✅ PDF compilé sur mobile !");
      } else {
        new Notice("⚠️ PDF généré mais non-lisible : " + (result.stderr || "diagnostic Typst"), 8000);
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("[mergdown2tex][mobile] PDF error:", e);
      new Notice("❌ Erreur PDF mobile: " + e.message);
    }
  }

      const wasmEngine = await this.getPandocWasmEngine();

        let full = inVaultSafe ? (relParentDir ? relParentDir + "/" : "") + imgRelRaw : imgRelRaw;

          found.push("/" + full);
        } else {
          missing.push(imgMatch[0]);

      }
      let pdfTexForPandoc = fullTex;

        for (const f of list) if (/\.bib$/i.test(f.path)) bibPaths.push(f.path);
      } catch (e) {}
      const resources = [...found];
      for (const b of bibPaths) resources.push("/" + b);

      // --- Tentatives progressives (typst supporte mal toc/embed selon le contenu)
      let result = null;
      let lastErr = "";
      let lastCmd = "";
      const cmdVariants = [

        { toc: false, std: false, math: true },
        { toc: false, std: false, math: false },
      ];
      const resPath = relParentDir ? "/" + relParentDir.replace(/\\/g, "/") : "/";
      for (const v of cmdVariants) {
        const flags = (numberSectionsFlag ? " --number-sections" : "") +
          (v.toc ? " --toc --toc-depth=6" : "") +
          (v.std ? " --standalone" : "") +
          (v.math ? " --mathml" : "");
        const cmd = `pandoc "${inputRel}" -t typst -o "${outputRel}" --resource-path="${resPath}"${flags}`;

        console.log("[mergdown2tex][mobile] running Pandoc WASM (typst):", cmd);

          if (result && result.stderr) console.log("[mergdown2tex][mobile] pandoc stderr:", result.stderr);
          try {
            const producedBytes = await vaultReadBinary(this.app, pdfRel);
            if (producedBytes && producedBytes.length > 4 &&
                producedBytes[0] === 0x25 && producedBytes[1] === 0x50) break;
          } catch (pe) {}
          lastErr = (result && result.stderr) || "aucun PDF produit";

        } catch (runErr) {
          lastErr = runErr.message;
          result = null;
        }
      }

      try { this.app.workspace.trigger("layout-change"); } catch (e) {}
      try { if (this.app.vault.adapter.trigger) this.app.vault.adapter.trigger("modify", pdfRel); } catch (e) {}

      const pdfBytes = await vaultReadBinary(this.app, pdfRel);
      if (pdfBytes && pdfBytes.length > 4 && pdfBytes[0] === 0x25 && pdfBytes[1] === 0x50) {
        new Notice("✅ PDF compilé sur mobile !");
      } else {

// fs/path/crypto/zlib/child_process n'existent pas sur Obsidian mobile.
// On les charge paresseusement UNIQUEMENT sur desktop, pour que le plugin
// puisse se charger et s'activer sur Android. Sur mobile, on expose des stubs
// dont chaque méthode lève une erreur claire si une fonction native (déjà
// gardée par Platform.isDesktop ou indisponible) est réellement appelée.
const _nativeModules = (() => {
  const isDesktop = typeof Platform !== "undefined" && !!Platform.isDesktop;
  if (!isDesktop) return {};
  try {
    const m = {};
    try { m.path = require("path"); } catch (e) { m.path = null; }
    try { m.fs = require("fs"); } catch (e) { m.fs = null; }
    try { m.crypto = require("crypto"); } catch (e) { m.crypto = null; }
    try { m.zlib = require("zlib"); } catch (e) { m.zlib = null; }
    try { m.exec = require("child_process").exec; } catch (e) { m.exec = null; }
    return m;
  } catch (e) { return {}; }
})();

const _stubUnavailable = (name) => () => { throw new Error("Module natif '" + name + "' indisponible sur mobile (Obsidian)"); };

function _nativeStub() {
  return new Proxy({}, {
    get(t, k) {
      if (k === "join") return ((...a) => a.join("/"));
      if (k === "dirname") return ((p) => String(p).replace(/\/?[^/]*$/, ""));
      if (k === "basename") return ((p) => String(p).split(/[\\/]/).pop());
      if (k === "extname") return ((p) => { const b = String(p).split(/[\\/]/).pop(); const i = b.lastIndexOf("."); return i > 0 ? b.slice(i) : ""; });
      if (k === "resolve") return ((...a) => a.join("/"));
      if (k === "relative") return ((from, to) => String(to));
      if (k === "sep") return "/";
      if (k === "isAbsolute") return ((p) => String(p).startsWith("/") || /^[A-Za-z]:/.test(String(p)));
      if (k === "getFullPath") return ((p) => p);
      if (k === "getBasePath") return (() => "/");
      if (k === "statSync") return ((p) => ({ size: 0 }));
      return _stubUnavailable("fs/path");
    },
  });
}

fn resolve_in_vfs(
    target: &str,
    vault_root: &str,
    md_path: &str,
    vfs: &HashMap<String, String>,
) -> Option<String> {
    let target = target.trim();
    if target.is_empty() {
        return None;
    }

    let p = PathBuf::from(target);
    let basename = p.file_name().and_then(|s| s.to_str()).unwrap_or(target);
    let basename_no_md = basename.trim_end_matches(".md");

    // Obsidian resolves `![[Name]]` / `[[Name]]` by note name across the vault,
    // so first try flat vfs keys (basename / basename without .md / raw target).
    for key in [target, basename, basename_no_md] {
        let k = key.replace('\\', "/");
        if let Some(content) = vfs.get(&k) {
            return Some(content.clone());
        }
        if let Some(content) = vfs.get(k.trim_end_matches(".md")) {
            return Some(content.clone());
        }
    }

    let candidates = if p.is_absolute() {
        vec![p.to_string_lossy().to_string()]
    } else {
        let mut c = Vec::new();
        // relative to md_path parent
        if let Some(parent) = PathBuf::from(md_path).parent() {
            c.push(parent.join(target).to_string_lossy().to_string());
            c.push(parent.join(basename).to_string_lossy().to_string());
            c.push(
                parent
                    .join(basename)
                    .with_extension("md")
                    .to_string_lossy()
                    .to_string(),
            );
        }
        // relative to vault_root
        c.push(
            PathBuf::from(vault_root)
                .join(target)
                .to_string_lossy()
                .to_string(),
        );
        c.push(
            PathBuf::from(vault_root)
                .join(basename)
                .to_string_lossy()
                .to_string(),
        );

  // Sur mobile, le VFS doit être peuplé pour que les embeds/wikilinks se résolvent.
  // Le WASM cherche par basename (nom sans .md) PUIS par chemins relatifs. On indexe
  // donc chaque note .md du vault par plusieurs clés (basename, basename+md, chemin).
  async buildVfsMobile() {
    const vfs = {};
    let files = [];
    try { files = this.app.vault.getFiles ? this.app.vault.getFiles() : []; } catch (e) {}
    for (const f of files) {
      if (!/\.md$/i.test(f.path)) continue;
      let c;
      try { c = await this.app.vault.read(f); } catch (e) { continue; }
      const norm = f.path.replace(/^\/+/, "").replace(/\\/g, "/");
      const basename = f.basename;
      const withoutExt = norm.replace(/\.md$/i, "");
      if (c) {
        if (basename && !vfs[basename]) vfs[basename] = c;
        if (!vfs[norm]) vfs[norm] = c;
        if (withoutExt && !vfs[withoutExt]) vfs[withoutExt] = c;
      }
    }
    return vfs;
  }

  async convertToLatexMobile(activeFile, vaultRoot, mdPath) {
    // Pipeline LaTeX simplifié pour mobile : utilise UNIQUEMENT le WASM embarqué
    // et app.vault.adapter (aucun fs/podman/mermaid).
    // NB: sur Android, activeFile.parent.path peut commencer par "/" ; on normalise
    // pour éviter des chemins "///Dossier avec espace/..." qui cassent les args pandoc.
    const parentDir = (activeFile.parent ? activeFile.parent.path : "").replace(/^\/+/, "");
    const fileStem = activeFile.basename;
    const content = await this.app.vault.read(activeFile);
    let processed = this.processDataviewInline(content, activeFile);
    // VFS peuplé (embeds + wikilinks résolus comme sur PC) : sans lui, les embeds
    // `![[Note]]` restent vides et le DOCX/PDF mobile diffère du PC.
    const vfs = await this.buildVfsMobile();
    const vfsJson = JSON.stringify(vfs);
    const expanded = this.vlatex.expand_wikilinks_with_vfs(processed, vaultRoot || "", mdPath || activeFile.path, vfsJson);
    const body = this.vlatex.markdown_to_latex_with_vfs(expanded, "default", vfsJson);
    const fullTex = this.assembleFullDocument(content, body, true, vaultRoot || "", parentDir || "");
    return { parentDir, fileStem, fullTex: fullTex.tex, content };

pub fn expand_wikilinks_with_vfs(
    content: &str,
    vault_root: &str,
    md_path: &str,
    vfs_json: &str,
) -> Result<String, JsValue> {
    let vfs: HashMap<String, String> = serde_json::from_str(vfs_json).unwrap_or_default();

    // Resolve `.md` embeds from the vfs, inlining cleaned content (+ `^id` for
    // block notes). Plain non-embed wikilinks are left for `to_local_links`.
    let result = expand_embeds_recursive(content, vault_root, md_path, &vfs, 0);

    Ok(result)
}

Status: Completed

fn expand_embeds_recursive(
    content: &str,
    vault_root: &str,
    md_path: &str,
    vfs: &HashMap<String, String>,
    depth: usize,
) -> String {
    if depth > 10 {
        return content.to_string();
    }
    lazy_static! {
        static ref EMBED_MD_RE: Regex =
            Regex::new(r"!\[\[([^\]|#]+)(?:#[^\]|]+)?(?:\|[^\]\n]+)?\]\]").unwrap();
    }
    // Obsidian block ids (`^id`) must be unique within a file. Track which block
    // slugs have already emitted their `^id` marker, so that embedding the same
    // block note more than once produces a single anchor (subsequent occurrences
    // inline the content without re-marking it, avoiding ambiguous duplicates).
    let mut seen: HashSet<String> = HashSet::new();
    let mut result = String::with_capacity(content.len());
    let mut last = 0;
    for caps in EMBED_MD_RE.captures_iter(content) {
        let m = caps.get(0).unwrap();
        result.push_str(&content[last..m.start()]);
        let full = m.as_str();
        let target = caps.get(1).unwrap().as_str();
        match resolve_in_vfs(target, vault_root, md_path, vfs) {
            Some(resolved) => {
                let inner =
                    expand_embeds_recursive(&resolved, vault_root, md_path, vfs, depth + 1);
                let cleaned = clean_block_content(&inner);
                if is_block_note(target) && !cleaned.is_empty() {
                    let slug = block_slug(target);
                    // Normaliser les équations d'une ligne en blocs math
                    // multi-ligne pour qu'Obsidian indexe l'ancre `^id` qui suit.
                    let body = normalize_equation_blocks(&cleaned);
                    if seen.insert(slug.clone()) {
                        result.push_str(&format!("{}\n^{}", body, slug));
                    } else {
                        result.push_str(&body);
                    }
                } else {
                    result.push_str(&cleaned);
                }
            }
            None => result.push_str(full),
        }
        last = m.end();
    }
    result.push_str(&content[last..]);
    result
}

  async expandToMd() {

      let { processed, vfs } = await this.processEmbedsWithMarkers(content, activeFile, vaultRoot, parentDir);
      const webCacheDir = path.join(parentDir, "embedded_images");
      processed = await ensureWebImages(processed, webCacheDir);

      // 2. Le WASM (Rust) convertit le contenu en Markdown autonome :
      //    - résout les wikilinks/embeds restants
      //    - remplace les liens .md par des ancres locales [↓ ...](#slug)
      //    - ajoute les ancres Markdown {#id} aux titres
      //    - injecte les marqueurs bidirectionnels %% BACKLINK: id ↑ %% (Option A)
      const vfsJson = JSON.stringify(vfs);
      let expanded = this.vlatex.expand_to_standalone_markdown(
        processed,
        vaultRoot,
        mdPath,
        vfsJson,
      );

      // 3. Écrire le fichier .expanded.md
      const expandedPath = path.join(parentDir, fileStem + ".expanded.md");
      const rel = path.relative(vaultRoot, expandedPath).split(path.sep).join("/");

      // façon de garder cohérents le TFile en mémoire, son stat (mtime/size) et le
      // metadataCache d'Obsidian (qui indexe les ancres de bloc `^id`). Une écriture
      // FS directe laisse Obsidian avec un cache stale → « Impossible de trouver ^id ».
      let file = this.app.vault.getAbstractFileByPath(rel);
      try {
        if (file && file.constructor && file.constructor.name === "TFile") {
          await this.app.vault.modify(file, expanded);
        } else if (file && file.children !== undefined) {
          // Fallback: `getAbstractFileByPath` a retourné un dossier → chemin invalide
          file = null;
        }
        if (!file) {
          file = await this.app.vault.create(rel, expanded);

        console.error("[mergdown2tex] app.vault write failed, falling back to FS:", vaultErr);
        fs.writeFileSync(expandedPath, expanded, "utf-8");
      }
      new Notice(`✅ Markdown étendu généré : ${fileStem}.expanded.md (${expanded.length} octets)`);
      return { expandedPath, vaultRoot, parentDir, fileStem, expanded };
    } catch (err) {
      console.error("[mergdown2tex] expandToMd error:", err);
      new Notice("❌ Erreur: " + err.message);
      return null;
    }

  async processEmbedsWithMarkers(content, sourceFile, vaultRoot, parentDir, depth = 0) {
    if (depth > 10) return { processed: content, vfs: {} };
    const vfs = {};

    const imgPattern = /!\[\[([^\]|#]+\.(?:png|jpg|jpeg|gif|svg|webp))(?:\|[^\]]*)?\]\]/gi;

      let resolved = this.app.metadataCache.getFirstLinkpathDest(fileRef, sourceFile.path);
      if (!resolved) return full;
      const absPath = path.join(vaultRoot, resolved.path);
      const relPath = path.relative(parentDir, absPath);
      return `![${resolved.basename}](${relPath})`;
    });

    processed = resolveImages(processed);

    // Embeds natifs .md : on lit le contenu brut de chaque note et on le met dans le vfs
    const mdPattern = /!\[\[([^\]|#]+)(?:#([^\]|]+))?(?:\|([^\]\n]+))?\]\]/g;

    let m;
    while ((m = mdPattern.exec(processed)) !== null) {
      const ext = path.extname(m[1]).slice(1).toLowerCase();
      if (!ext || ext === 'md') matches.push({ fileRef: m[1] });

  async processEmbeds(content, sourceFile, vaultRoot, parentDir, depth = 0) {
    if (depth > 10) return { processed: content, vfs: {} };
    const vfs = {};
    let processed = content;

    const mermaidRegex = /```mermaid\s*\n([\s\S]+?)```/g;
    let mermaidMatch;
    let mermaidIndex = 0;
    const cacheDir = path.join(parentDir, "mermaid_diagrams");
    if (!fs.existsSync(cacheDir)) {
      fs.mkdirSync(cacheDir, { recursive: true });
    }

    const mermaidReplacements = [];
    while ((mermaidMatch = mermaidRegex.exec(content)) !== null) {
      const def = mermaidMatch[1];
      const original = mermaidMatch[0];
      const mmdPath = path.join(
        cacheDir,
        `diagram_${Date.now()}_${mermaidIndex}.mmd`,
      );
      const pngPath = path.join(
        cacheDir,
        `diagram_${Date.now()}_${mermaidIndex}.png`,
      );
      fs.writeFileSync(mmdPath, def);
      mermaidReplacements.push({ original, def, mmdPath, pngPath });
      mermaidIndex++;
    }

    for (let i = 0; i < mermaidReplacements.length; i++) {
      const r = mermaidReplacements[i];
      const original = r.original, def = r.def, mmdPath = r.mmdPath, pngPath = r.pngPath;
      try {
        await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          const mmdcCmd = `mmdc -i "${mmdPath}" -o "${pngPath}" -b white`;
          exec(mmdcCmd, (error) => {
            if (error) reject(error);
            else resolve();
          });
        });
        const captionText = (def.trim().split('\n')[0] || 'Diagramme')
          .replace(/[&%$#_{}~^\\<>|]/g, (c) => '\\' + c)
          .slice(0, 60);
        processed = processed.replace(
          original,
          `\\begin{figure}[H]\n\\centering\n\\includegraphics[width=1.0\\linewidth,height=0.4\\textheight,keepaspectratio]{mermaid_diagrams/${path.basename(pngPath)}}\n\\caption{${captionText}}\n\\end{figure}`,
        );
        fs.unlinkSync(mmdPath);
      } catch (e) {
        console.error("[mergdown2tex] mermaid error:", e);
      }
    }

    const pattern = /!\[\[([^\]|#]+)(?:#([^\]|]+))?(?:\|([^\]\n]+))?\]\]/g;
    const matches = [];
    let m;
    while ((m = pattern.exec(processed)) !== null) {
      matches.push({ full: m[0], fileRef: m[1] });
    }

    for (const { full, fileRef } of matches) {
      let resolved = this.app.metadataCache.getFirstLinkpathDest(
        fileRef,
        sourceFile.path,
      );
      let absPath = "";
      let extension = "";

      if (!resolved) {
        if (path.isAbsolute(fileRef) && fs.existsSync(fileRef)) {
          absPath = fileRef;
          extension = path.extname(fileRef).slice(1);
        } else {
          console.log("[mergdown2tex] cannot resolve embed:", fileRef);
          continue;
        }
      } else {
        absPath = path.join(vaultRoot, resolved.path);
        extension = resolved.extension;
      }

      if (extension === "md") {
        if (!vfs[absPath] && resolved) {
          const rawContent = await this.app.vault.read(resolved);
          const { processed: pContent } = await this.processEmbeds(
            rawContent,
            resolved,
            vaultRoot,
            parentDir,
            depth + 1,
          );
          vfs[absPath] = pContent;
        }
      } else if (
        ["png", "jpg", "jpeg", "gif", "svg", "webp"].includes(extension)
      ) {
        const relPath = path.relative(parentDir, absPath);
        processed = processed.replaceAll(
          full,
          `\\includegraphics[width=0.95\\linewidth]{${relPath}}`,
        );
      }
    }
    return { processed, vfs };
  }

  // Sur mobile, le VFS doit être peuplé pour que les embeds/wikilinks se résolvent.
  // Le WASM cherche par basename (nom sans .md) PUIS par chemins relatifs. On indexe
  // donc chaque note .md du vault par plusieurs clés (basename, basename+md, chemin).
  async buildVfsMobile() {
    const vfs = {};
    let files = [];
    try { files = this.app.vault.getFiles ? this.app.vault.getFiles() : []; } catch (e) {}
    for (const f of files) {
      if (!/\.md$/i.test(f.path)) continue;
      let c;
      try { c = await this.app.vault.read(f); } catch (e) { continue; }
      const norm = f.path.replace(/^\/+/, "").replace(/\\/g, "/");
      const basename = f.basename;
      const withoutExt = norm.replace(/\.md$/i, "");
      if (c) {
        if (basename && !vfs[basename]) vfs[basename] = c;
        if (!vfs[norm]) vfs[norm] = c;
        if (withoutExt && !vfs[withoutExt]) vfs[withoutExt] = c;
      }
    }
    return vfs;
  }

  async convertToLatexMobile(activeFile, vaultRoot, mdPath) {
    // Pipeline LaTeX simplifié pour mobile : utilise UNIQUEMENT le WASM embarqué
    // et app.vault.adapter (aucun fs/podman/mermaid).
    // NB: sur Android, activeFile.parent.path peut commencer par "/" ; on normalise
    // pour éviter des chemins "///Dossier avec espace/..." qui cassent les args pandoc.
    const parentDir = (activeFile.parent ? activeFile.parent.path : "").replace(/^\/+/, "");
    const fileStem = activeFile.basename;
    const content = await this.app.vault.read(activeFile);
    let processed = this.processDataviewInline(content, activeFile);
    // VFS peuplé (embeds + wikilinks résolus comme sur PC) : sans lui, les embeds
    // `![[Note]]` restent vides et le DOCX/PDF mobile diffère du PC.
    const vfs = await this.buildVfsMobile();
    const vfsJson = JSON.stringify(vfs);
    const expanded = this.vlatex.expand_wikilinks_with_vfs(processed, vaultRoot || "", mdPath || activeFile.path, vfsJson);
    const body = this.vlatex.markdown_to_latex_with_vfs(expanded, "default", vfsJson);
    const fullTex = this.assembleFullDocument(content, body, true, vaultRoot || "", parentDir || "");
    return { parentDir, fileStem, fullTex: fullTex.tex, content };
  }

  async compileDocxMobile() {
    if (!this.vlatex) { new Notice("vLaTeX WASM non initialisé."); return; }
    const activeFile = this.app.workspace.getActiveFile();
    if (!activeFile || activeFile.extension !== "md") { new Notice("Sélectionnez un fichier Markdown."); return; }
    new Notice("Compilation DOCX (Pandoc WASM)...");
    try {
      const { parentDir, fileStem, fullTex, content } = await this.convertToLatexMobile(activeFile);
      const docxTex = this.vlatex.prepare_latex_for_docx_full(fullTex, this.settings.keepNavArrows, this.settings.defaultTableWidth || "0.95");
      const relParentDir = parentDir || "";

      // Génère aussi le .expanded.md du processus (même source que le DOCX),
      // pour que l'utilisateur garde le markdown autonome associé à l'export.
      try {
        const relParent = (activeFile.parent ? activeFile.parent.path : "").replace(/^\/+/, "");
        const expandedRel = (relParent ? relParent + "/" : "") + activeFile.basename + ".expanded.md";
        const vfsJson = JSON.stringify(await this.buildVfsMobile());
        const expanded = this.vlatex.expand_to_standalone_markdown(
          this.processDataviewInline(content, activeFile), "", activeFile.path, vfsJson,
        );
        await vaultMkdir(this.app, relParent || "/");
        await vaultWriteText(this.app, expandedRel, expanded);
        console.log("[mergdown2tex][mobile] .expanded.md écrit (processus DOCX):", expandedRel);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn("[mergdown2tex][mobile] .expanded.md du processus DOCX non généré:", (e && e.message) || e);
      }

      const docxTexRel = (relParentDir ? relParentDir + "/" : "") + fileStem + "_docx.tex";
      const docxRel = (relParentDir ? relParentDir + "/" : "") + fileStem + ".docx";
      const docxPreamble = `\\documentclass{article}\n\\usepackage[utf8]{inputenc}\n\\usepackage[T1]{fontenc}\n\\usepackage{hyperref}\n\\usepackage{xcolor}\n\\hypersetup{ colorlinks=true, linkcolor=blue, urlcolor=blue, citecolor=blue }\n\\begin{document}\n`;
      const docxTexEval = docxTex
        .replace(/\\begin\{document\}/g, '').replace(/\\end\{document\}/g, '')
        .replace(/\\documentclass\s*\[[^\]]*\]\s*\{[^}]*\}/g, '').replace(/\\documentclass\s*\{[^}]*\}/g, '')
        .replace(/\\usepackage\s*(?:\[[^\]]*\])?\s*\{[^}]*\}/g, '').replace(/\\RequirePackage\s*(?:\[[^\]]*\])?\s*\{[^}]*\}/g, '')
        .replace(/\\documentstyle\s*(?:\[[^\]]*\])?\s*\{[^}]*\}/g, '');
      // Écrit le _docx.tex via adapter (le contenu finalisé/neutralisé est écrit

      await vaultMkdir(this.app, relParentDir || "/");

      const wasmFS = new WasmFileSystem(this.app.vault, "");
      const numberSectionsFlag = this.settings.enableDocxNumbering ? " --number-sections" : "";
      const inputRel = ("/" + docxTexRel).replace(/\\/g, "/");
      const outputRel = ("/" + docxRel).replace(/\\/g, "/");

/// `tex_content` is the same LaTeX (preprocessed) that was passed to pandoc,
/// used to build the cite_key → cite_call_N mapping.
#[wasm_bindgen]
pub fn modify_docx_arrows(docx_bytes: &[u8], tex_content: &str) -> Vec<u8> {
    let key_map = crate::latex::docx::build_cite_key_map(tex_content);
    let cite_call_count = key_map.values().copied().max().unwrap_or(0);
    if cite_call_count == 0 {
        return docx_bytes.to_vec();
    }
    match crate::latex::docx::add_return_arrows_to_bytes(docx_bytes, cite_call_count, &key_map) {
        Ok(bytes) => bytes,
        Err(_) => docx_bytes.to_vec(),
    }
}

use regex::Regex;

const ALIGNED_CMDS: &[&str] = &["aligned", "align", "split"];

pub fn join_multiline_display_math(lines: &[String]) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut result: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < lines.len() {
        let line = lines[i].trim();
        if line.starts_with("$$") || line.starts_with(r"\[") {
            let mut block = vec![line.to_string()];
            let mut closed = false;
            if line.ends_with("$$") || line.ends_with(r"\]") {
                closed = true;
            }
            i += 1;
            while i < lines.len() && !closed {
                let next = lines[i].trim();
                block.push(next.to_string());
                if next.ends_with("$$") || next.ends_with(r"\]") {
                    closed = true;
                }
                i += 1;
            }
            result.push(block.join(" "));
        } else {
            result.push(lines[i].clone());
            i += 1;
        }
    }
    result
}

pub fn convert_non_numbered_to_numbered(lines: &[String]) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut result: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut in_block = false;
    for line in lines {
        let trimmed = line.trim();
        if trimmed == "$$" {
            if in_block {
                result.push(r"\end{equation}".to_string());
                in_block = false;
            } else {
                result.push(r"\begin{equation}".to_string());
                in_block = true;
            }
        } else if trimmed.starts_with("$$") && trimmed.len() > 2 {
            let inner = trimmed.trim_start_matches("$$").trim_end_matches("$$").trim();
            result.push(format!(r"\begin{{equation}}{}", inner));
            result.push(r"\end{equation}".to_string());
        } else if trimmed == r"\[" {
            result.push(r"\begin{equation}".to_string());
            in_block = true;
        } else if trimmed == r"\]" {
            result.push(r"\end{equation}".to_string());
            in_block = false;
        } else if trimmed.starts_with(r"\[") && trimmed.len() > 2 {
            let inner = trimmed.trim_start_matches(r"\[").trim();
            result.push(format!(r"\begin{{equation}}{}", inner));
            result.push(r"\end{equation}".to_string());
        } else {
            result.push(line.clone());
        }
    }
    if in_block {
        result.push(r"\end{equation}".to_string());
    }
    result
}

pub fn correct_aligned_equation(content: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let re = Regex::new(r"\\begin\{aligned\}(.*?)\\end\{aligned\}").unwrap();
    if !re.is_match(content) {
        return None;
    }
    let result = re.replace_all(content, |caps: &regex::Captures| {
        format!(r"\begin{{equation}}\begin{{aligned}}{}\end{{aligned}}\end{{equation}}", &caps[1])
    }).to_string();
    let result = result.trim_start_matches("$$").trim_end_matches("$$").trim();
    Some(result.to_string())
}

pub fn convert_equation_referencing(lines: &[String], _cleveref: bool) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut result = Vec::new();
    let re = Regex::new(r"\\ref\{([^}]+)\}").unwrap();
    for line in lines {
        let s = re.replace_all(line, |caps: &regex::Captures| {
            let target = &caps[1];
            let prefix = if target.starts_with("eq__block_") { "eq:" } else { "" };
            format!(r"\ref{{{}{}}}", prefix, target)
        }).to_string();
        result.push(s);
    }
    result
}

    static ref FM_BLOCK_RE: Regex =

    static ref BLANK_RUN_RE: Regex = Regex::new(r"\n{3,}").unwrap();

/// Strip Obsidian property blocks, metadata lines and the template header/marker
/// lines (e.g. `# %%expr%%`, `%% fig %%`, `` `=this.caption` ``) from a note's
/// content so that when it is inlined its body appears clean, without leaking
/// `\section{...}` / stray text into the converted LaTeX.
///
/// Obsidian `%%...%%` are comments and, crucially, can span multiple lines with
/// `%%` on their own lines (as used by the block-note property blocks) or be
/// glued to content (e.g. `%%| Some more text...`). A naive same-line regex
/// leaves these `%%` in place; once inlined they split / break markdown tables
/// and corrupt Obsidian's document parse (which also breaks block references).
/// So first do a line-based pass that drops standalone `%%` comment lines /
/// blocks and strips a leading `%%` glued to a line, then the regex cleanups.
fn clean_block_content(content: &str) -> String {
    let mut lines: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut in_comment = false;
    for raw in content.lines() {
        let line = raw.trim_end();
        let trimmed = line.trim();
        if trimmed == "%%" || trimmed == "%%%" {
            // Standalone `%%` (or `%%%`) toggles an Obsidian comment block.
            in_comment = !in_comment;
            continue;
        }
        if in_comment {
            continue;
        }
        // Strip a leading `%%` glued to content (e.g. `%%| Some table row ...`),
        // used to comment out a single row. Only when the `%%` is a *single*
        // opening marker with no closing `%%` on the same line; a balanced
        // `%%...%%` (e.g. `%% fig %%`) must be left intact so the template-marker
        // regexes below can remove it as a whole.
        let cleaned = if trimmed.starts_with("%%")
            && line.trim_start() == trimmed
            && !trimmed[2..].contains("%%")
        {
            trimmed
                .trim_start_matches("%%")
                .trim_start_matches(|c: char| c.is_whitespace())
                .to_string()
        } else {
            line.to_string()
        };
        lines.push(cleaned);
    }
    let mut out = lines.join("\n");
    out = FM_BLOCK_RE.replace_all(&out, "").into_owned();
    out = META_LINE_RE.replace_all(&out, "").into_owned();
    out = BLOCK_HEADER_RE.replace_all(&out, "").into_owned();
    out = BLOCK_MARKER_RE.replace_all(&out, "").into_owned();
    out = DV_CAPTION_RE.replace_all(&out, "").into_owned();
    out = BLANK_RUN_RE.replace_all(&out, "\n\n").into_owned();
    out.trim().to_string()
}

/// a direct `<a id="slug"></a>` anchor (emitted by the plugin for embeds and
/// by `add_anchors_to_headers` for headings), so the links resolve in plain
/// Markdown and convert to the same LaTeX as a direct conversion.
fn to_local_links(content: &str) -> String {
    lazy_static! {
        // [alias](file.md#anchor) or [alias](file.md) (skips ![..] markdown images via `!?`)
        static ref MD_LINK_RE: Regex =
            Regex::new(r"!?\[([^\]]+)\]\(([^#)]+\.md)(?:#([^)]+))?\)").unwrap();
        // [[file#anchor|alias]], [[file#anchor]], [[file|alias]], embeds ![[..]] excluded
        static ref WIKI_RE: Regex =
            Regex::new(r"!?\[\[([^\]|#]+)(?:#([^\]|]+))?(?:\|([^\]\n]+))?\]\]").unwrap();
    }

    // First: convert markdown links to .md files (skip embedded/markdown images)
    let step1 = MD_LINK_RE.replace_all(content, |caps: &regex::Captures| {
        if caps.get(0).unwrap().as_str().starts_with('!') {
            return caps.get(0).unwrap().as_str().to_string();
        }
        let alias = caps.get(1).unwrap().as_str();
        let target = caps.get(2).unwrap().as_str();
        let anchor = caps.get(3).map(|m| m.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
        // Block-note refs become self-contained Obsidian block references that
        // resolve to the `^<id>` marker placed at the inlined content in this
        // same file:  [..](eq__block_1.md)  ->  [[#^eq--block-1|..]]
        if anchor.is_empty() && is_block_note(target) {
            return format!("[[#^{}|{}]]", block_slug(target), alias);
        }
        let section_id = link_section_id(target, anchor);
        format!("[[#{}|{}]]", section_id, alias)
    });

    // Then: convert any remaining non-embed wikilinks (embeds are already resolved)
    let step2 = WIKI_RE.replace_all(&step1, |caps: &regex::Captures| {
        if caps.get(0).unwrap().as_str().starts_with('!') {
            return caps.get(0).unwrap().as_str().to_string();
        }
        let target = caps.get(1).unwrap().as_str();
        let anchor = caps.get(2).map(|m| m.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
        let alias = caps.get(3).map(|m| m.as_str()).unwrap_or("");
        // Block-note cross-refs become self-contained Obsidian block reference
        // wikilinks that resolve to the `^<id>` marker of the inlined content in
        // this same file:
        //   [[eq__block_1]]  ->  [[#^eq--block-1|eq__block_1]]
        if anchor.is_empty() && is_block_note(target) {
            let name = target
                .trim_end_matches(".md")
                .rsplit(['/', '\\'])
                .next()
                .unwrap_or(target);
            let text = if alias.is_empty() { name } else { alias };
            return format!("[[#^{}|{}]]", block_slug(target), text);
        }
        let link_text = if alias.is_empty() {
            if anchor.is_empty() {
                target.trim_end_matches(".md").to_string()
            } else {
                anchor.to_string()
            }
        } else {
            alias.to_string()
        };
        let section_id = link_section_id(target, anchor);
        format!("[[#{}|{}]]", section_id, link_text)
    });

    step2.into_owned()
}

Donc le bug est RÉELLEMENT dans le source actuel, pas seulement dans un wasm périmé. C'est la confirmation décisive : je dois **corriger le source Rust**.

Le déclencheur minimal : équation `$$ \begin{aligned}...\end{aligned}$$` suivie d'un caractère non-espace (`.`, `;`, texte) → **perdue**. Et le probe4 (2 équations avec heading + texte) → crash/imbrication cassée.

**La correction** : dans `convert_remaining_dollar_math` (l.700-740), le `DOLLAR_BLOCK` `(?s)\$\$(.+?)\$\$` ne matche pas quand il y a du texte collé après le `$$` fermant — car le non-avide `(.+?)` prend le PLUS PETIT `$$...$$`, mais s'il y a `$$...$$.` le `.` n'est pas un problème pour le match... 

Attends. Re-réfléchissons. Le regex `(?s)\$\$(.+?)\$\$` sur `$$ \begin{aligned}\nA\nB\n\end{aligned}$$.` :
- Le non-avide `(.+?)` cherche le premier `$$` qui suit le `$$` de départ. La première occurrence de `\$\$` après le début — c'est dans `\end{aligned}$$.`. Donc il matche correctement en s'arrêtant au `$$` de fermeture (avant le point). Donc ça DEVRAIT matcher.

Mais le résultat est 0/0 = PAS de match du tout, l'équation entière disparaît (remplacée par rien). Pourquoi ? Peut-être que `correct_aligned_equation` ou `join_multiline_display_math` retourne une chaîne vide.

En fait, le `inner` capture = `\begin{aligned}\nA\nB\n\end{aligned}` (trim). `wrapped` = `$$\begin{aligned}\nA\nB\n\end{aligned}$$`. `correct_aligned_equation(&wrapped)` — regardons sa logique exacte (l.71 equations.rs). Le regex n'a pas `s`, `.` ne matche pas `\n`, donc sur le wrapped multi-ligne → `is_match` false → None. Puis `join_multiline_display_math` sur `vec![wrapped]`. use regex::Regex;

const ALIGNED_CMDS: &[&str] = &["aligned", "align", "split"];

pub fn join_multiline_display_math(lines: &[String]) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut result: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut i = 0;
    while i < lines.len() {
        let line = lines[i].trim();
        if line.starts_with("$$") || line.starts_with(r"\[") {
            let mut block = vec![line.to_string()];
            let mut closed = false;
            if line.ends_with("$$") || line.ends_with(r"\]") {
                closed = true;
            }
            i += 1;
            while i < lines.len() && !closed {
                let next = lines[i].trim();
                block.push(next.to_string());
                if next.ends_with("$$") || next.ends_with(r"\]") {
                    closed = true;
                }
                i += 1;
            }
            result.push(block.join(" "));
        } else {
            result.push(lines[i].clone());
            i += 1;
        }
    }
    result
}

pub fn convert_non_numbered_to_numbered(lines: &[String]) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut result: Vec<String> = Vec::new();
    let mut in_block = false;
    for line in lines {
        let trimmed = line.trim();
        if trimmed == "$$" {
            if in_block {
                result.push(r"\end{equation}".to_string());
                in_block = false;
            } else {
                result.push(r"\begin{equation}".to_string());
                in_block = true;
            }
        } else if trimmed.starts_with("$$") && trimmed.len() > 2 {
            let inner = trimmed.trim_start_matches("$$").trim_end_matches("$$").trim();
            result.push(format!(r"\begin{{equation}}{}", inner));
            result.push(r"\end{equation}".to_string());
        } else if trimmed == r"\[" {
            result.push(r"\begin{equation}".to_string());
            in_block = true;
        } else if trimmed == r"\]" {
            result.push(r"\end{equation}".to_string());
            in_block = false;
        } else if trimmed.starts_with(r"\[") && trimmed.len() > 2 {
            let inner = trimmed.trim_start_matches(r"\[").trim();
            result.push(format!(r"\begin{{equation}}{}", inner));
            result.push(r"\end{equation}".to_string());
        } else {
            result.push(line.clone());
        }
    }
    if in_block {
        result.push(r"\end{equation}".to_string());
    }
    result
}

pub fn correct_aligned_equation(content: &str) -> Option<String> {
    let re = Regex::new(r"\\begin\{aligned\}(.*?)\\end\{aligned\}").unwrap();
    if !re.is_match(content) {
        return None;
    }
    let result = re.replace_all(content, |caps: &regex::Captures| {
        format!(r"\begin{{equation}}\begin{{aligned}}{}\end{{aligned}}\end{{equation}}", &caps[1])
    }).to_string();
    let result = result.trim_start_matches("$$").trim_end_matches("$$").trim();
    Some(result.to_string())
}

pub fn convert_equation_referencing(lines: &[String], _cleveref: bool) -> Vec<String> {
    let mut result = Vec::new();
    let re = Regex::new(r"\\ref\{([^}]+)\}").unwrap();
    for line in lines {
        let s = re.replace_all(line, |caps: &regex::Captures| {
            let target = &caps[1];
            let prefix = if target.starts_with("eq__block_") { "eq:" } else { "" };
            format!(r"\ref{{{}{}}}", prefix, target)
        }).to_string();
        result.push(s);
    }
    result
}

      let pdfTexForPandoc = fullTex;

      // --- Bibliographie : ne fournir que les chemins .bib présents dans le vault

        for (const f of list) if (/\.bib$/i.test(f.path)) bibPaths.push(f.path);
      } catch (e) {}
      const resources = [...found];
      for (const b of bibPaths) resources.push("/" + b);

      // --- Tentatives progressives (typst supporte mal toc/embed selon le contenu)

      let lastErr = "";
      let lastCmd = "";

        { toc: false, std: false, math: false },
      ];

async function vaultReadBinary(app, relPath) {
  const asBytes = (x) => {
    if (!x) return null;
    if (x instanceof Uint8Array) return x;
    if (typeof ArrayBuffer !== "undefined" && x instanceof ArrayBuffer) return new Uint8Array(x);
    if (typeof x.buffer === "object" && x.buffer instanceof ArrayBuffer) return new Uint8Array(x.buffer, x.byteOffset || 0, x.byteLength || x.length);
    if (typeof Buffer !== "undefined" && Buffer.isBuffer(x)) return new Uint8Array(x.buffer, x.byteOffset, x.byteLength);
    if (x.length || x.byteLength) return new Uint8Array(x.buffer || x);
    return null;
  };
  const a = adapterGet(app);
  if (a && typeof a.readBinary === "function") {
    try { return asBytes(await a.readBinary(relPath)); } catch (e) { /* fallback */ }
  }
  const p = requirePathOrNull();
  const root = app && app.vault && app.vault.adapter && app.vault.adapter.getBasePath ? app.vault.adapter.getBasePath() : null;
  if (p && root) {
    const abs = p.join(root, relPath);
    return asBytes(fs.readFileSync(abs));
  }
  throw new Error("Lecture binaire impossible: " + relPath);
}

async function vaultWriteBinary(app, relPath, data) {

  const a = adapterGet(app);
  if (a && typeof a.writeBinary === "function") {

    const dir = p.dirname(abs);

    fs.writeFileSync(abs, Buffer.from(bytes));
    return;
  }
  throw new Error("Écriture binaire impossible: " + relPath);
}

async function vaultMkdir(app, relPath) {
  const a = adapterGet(app);
  if (a && typeof a.mkdir === "function") {
    try { await a.mkdir(relPath); return; } catch (e) { /* fallback */ }
  }
  const p = requirePathOrNull();

async function vaultExists(app, relPath) {
  const a = adapterGet(app);
  if (a && typeof a.exists === "function") {
    try { return await a.exists(relPath); } catch (e) { /* fallback */ }
  }

  return false;

const _crcTable = (() => {
  const t = new Uint32Array(256);
  for (let n = 0; n < 256; n++) {
    let c = n;
    for (let k = 0; k < 8; k++) c = (c & 1) ? (0xedb88320 ^ (c >>> 1)) : (c >>> 1);

  }

})();
